corners.label: T1
corners.braking: Brake markers on the wall, 40-50% initial, taper to 10-5% through corner.
corners.line: Turn down and wrap first seam, left front on seam.
corners.exit: Increase throttle, get back to seam on exit.
corners.mistakes: Left front above seam: no front turn; straddling seam: high-side loose.

corners.label: T1
corners.line: Get back down to the seam and cover the left front with the hash mark.
corners.exit: Use partial throttle to avoid rear slip, increase throttle off the corner.
corners.mistakes: Overdrive the center to get it stable, back off throttle to reset turn, then finish with more throttle.

corners.braking: Brake between the three and two brake markers, slightly less early.
corners.line: Run below the seam on entry to shortcut the corner.

corners.label: T4
corners.line: diamond similar to one and two
corners.exit: lots of throttle and go to drive it back down the track before getting a nice straight exit and driving out to the wall
corners.mistakes: don't throttle up too much too soon on exit and spin the rear

corners.braking: brake early to avoid right rear getting hung up on transition
corners.line: enter on apron, keep on apron
corners.mistakes: right rear too high, car will be loose

corners.braking: Brake late, staying above the second set of hash marks
corners.line: Turn in wide, apexing on the top, exit in the second groove
corners.exit: Maximize exit speed, use grip for forward drive
corners.mistakes: Running too close to the darker asphalt, entering pit road from the middle of the track

corners.braking: Big brake at the bump, watch the commitment line
corners.line: Cut sharply down to the third groove
corners.exit: Maintain pit road speed, drive straight to commitment line
corners.mistakes: Watch out for the bump, avoid the grass, stay below the paint, be careful with the wall
